items.title: Unit 1 · Our new things
items.scene: My name's Peter. I go to Orange Park School. Look at these pictures of my school. Our classroom is upstairs. It's very big and bright. There are lots of pictures and posters on the wall. I'm in class 3C. There are 12 girls and 14 boys in my class. Our teacher is Mrs Cooper. We sit at tables. I sit with my friend Henry. There is a swimming pool, too. I love my school.
